content.value_statement: ModelArts resources and workflows span many services and operational areas. This skill organizes authentication guidance, module topics, and intended resource-management capabilities.
actual_capabilities: Explains notebook and local authentication modes at a high level.
Maps ModelArts topics to named reference documents.
Catalogs intended modules for notebooks, pools, training, inference, networking, and keys.
Lists supported resource-management workflows by module.
Describes a planned modular architecture and unified API pattern.
limitations: The package contains only README.md and SKILL.md.
The referenced modules, scripts, and documentation files are not included.
It cannot directly call Huawei Cloud APIs in its current form.
Its security and credential-handling claims cannot be verified from included implementation code.

use_cases.title: Plan ModelArts Operations
use_cases.description: Identify the documented module associated with a planned notebook, training, inference, or resource-pool task.

use_cases.title: Review Service Coverage
use_cases.description: Compare the listed ModelArts, OBS, VPC, KMS, SWR, and Lite Server workflow areas.

use_cases.title: Outline ML Infrastructure
use_cases.description: Organize intended cloud resources for training, deployment, storage, networking, and compute management.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Module
prompt_templates.prompt: Which documented module covers [ModelArts task], and what related capabilities are listed?
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need basic topic routing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline a ModelArts workflow for [goal] using only capabilities documented in this skill. State which implementation files are missing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when planning a cloud operation without executing it.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Service Areas
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the documented roles of [service one] and [service two] for [workload]. Include dependencies and package limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when selecting between documented resource areas.

prompt_templates.title: Assess an Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed ModelArts architecture: [details]. Map each component to documented modules, identify unsupported assumptions, and list required verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced architecture review and gap analysis.

output_examples.input: Which area covers scaling a node pool?
output_examples.output: The node pool area is listed for scaling node groups and managing additional pools. Its referenced implementation is not included in this package.

output: Notebook mode: automatic ModelArts environment detection.
Local mode: environment variables for access key, secret key, project, and region.
Credential-handling behavior cannot be verified because implementation files are absent.

output_examples.output: Review the listed v1 and v2 inference areas, then verify service lifecycle, version, health, region, and login behavior against current Huawei documentation.

best_practices: Verify every planned operation against current Huawei Cloud documentation.
Use least-privilege credentials and review destructive actions before execution.
Treat referenced capabilities as unverified until the missing implementation files are available.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the listed modules exist in this package.
Do not expose access keys, secret keys, or security tokens in prompts.
Do not execute destructive cloud operations from documentation alone.

faq.question: Does this package directly manage ModelArts resources?
faq.answer: No. The included package provides documentation, but the referenced scripts and modules are absent.

faq.question: Which authentication modes are described?
faq.answer: It describes automatic notebook authentication and local authentication through environment variables.

faq.question: Can it manage notebooks and OBS storage?
faq.answer: SKILL.md lists those intended capabilities, but their implementation is not included.

faq.question: Does it cover training and inference?
faq.answer: It lists training workflows and two inference service areas, including lifecycle and monitoring topics.

faq.question: Are credentials visible to the AI assistant?
faq.answer: The document claims credentials remain internal, but included files do not provide implementation evidence.

faq.question: What should I verify before using this skill?
faq.answer: Confirm that required modules exist, inspect credential handling, and validate all operations against current Huawei Cloud APIs.
